description: Dependencies a UI slice's MERGE has but its declared dependsOn does not state: the slice gate judges each bound governed journey assertion against api.github.com (SLICE-EXECUTION-PLAN.md section 4), so a slice bound to an assertion that connects, lists, saves or reloads cannot pass before the slices that make that real. Derived from the slice's governedAssertions in slice-execution-manifest.successor.json and the journey steps in verification/journeys/*.spec.mjs. Applied to BOTH policies, so the current plan is not credited with merges its gate would refuse. Not modelled: ODR-R10-25/-26 (the frozen contracts cannot represent causa-data), a blocker that no ordering removes.

rules.why: Connect against the real provider (support.mjs connect)
the run first starts an investigation and saves it to GitHub (startInvestigation, saveAndConfirm in support.mjs) on the live write path
a fresh browser context connects, lists the saved investigation and opens it from GitHub
